notes.title: My Little Universe v1.3.0 - Fishing Expansion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767482/20bb517a9b959ff20ac77170f48311a855322f68.png[/img]
. Fishing is a part that definitely needs an expansion so we decided to add more diversity to the items you can receive when fishing. Also the character now does not require you to spend 25k fish oil, it works as an achievement skin instead - meaning you can still enjoy the buffs from the [b]Mr. Fish's Shop[/b] and receive the character once you have 25k collected.

Have a wonderful weekend, see you next week!

- balance adjustments

- balance adjustments

- balance adjustments

notes.title: My Little Universe v1.2.0 - Balance Tweaks & Booster Cards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767482/20bb517a9b959ff20ac77170f48311a855322f68.png[/img]
Fellow players, this Wednesdays update brings much awaited changes to the booster cards. This is not all we will do to further improve the overall experience & interaction with this game mechanic, we are planning to expand it to make it possible for players to gather their own sets of boosters, that will help them along the way in exploring the vast universe. 

[h2]Booster Card Adjustments[/h2]
- Players [b]no longer lose all booster cards[/b] upon death
- Players will now [b]lose only one random card[/b] upon death
- Added [b]booster discard functionality[/b] in the cards screen, so players can discard unwanted boosters 

[h2]Planet Changes[/h2]
[b]Trollheim Planet[/b]
- Balance adjustments were made to the swamp area, requires less wood for area completion

[b]Odysseum Dungeon - Gigantomachy[/b]
- Created a safer route to the secret zone

[b]Odysseum Dungeon - Shmoseidon[/b]
- Invisible wall colliders have been added to the underwater zone to prevent accidental deaths during exploration
- A unique Poseidon statue now marks the entrance to the secret zone, set apart from other statues with enhanced visual effects
- The exit portal has been enhanced with visual effects to guide players more clearly

[b]Dragonora Dungeon - Dominion Fireworks Inc.[/b]
- Fixed invisible construction square 

[b]Egyptium Dungeon - Embalming Room[/b]
- Fixed the sunbeam puzzle's soft lock that restricted players from progressing 

[h2]Bug Fixes and Technical Improvements[/h2]
- Players are able to pick up previously owned skin pickups in other save profiles
- Resolved an issue where the second tutorial step wasn't compatible with mouse input
- Improved radial menu navigation with a mouse in CO-OP mode
- Adjusted radial menu scaling for 3-player sessions
- Corrected screen scaling for the fishing shop in 3-player games
- Addressed an issue where player controls would disconnect if attacked by a shark, potentially halting progress
- Fixed "The End" achievement; it now correctly unlocks upon completing the Asium planet
- Fixed an issue where some resource icons where missing for Odysseum in portal screen

notes.title: My Little Universe v1.1.6 - Balance Tweaks & More
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767482/20bb517a9b959ff20ac77170f48311a855322f68.png[/img]
[b]Good day fellow players[/b],

First of all I would like to [b]thank everyone[/b] for being very active in the discussion forums & discord bringing lot of cool ideas to the table. We are looking into your feedback & we hear you - booster card system is gonna have mechanic adjustments soon. It definitely does feel very punishing for players who like to have a more chill like experience with a great set of cards, thus card discarding will be added & punishment for death won't be as harsh, stay tuned for more details in next update this week.

Meanwhile here are the patch notes for [b]version 1.1.6[/b]

[h2]Booster Cards[/h2]
[b]Card Adjustments[/b]
Bounty Hunter Card: "Extra Coin" buff now increased from [b]25% to 30%[/b]
Swimmer Card: Swimming speed decreased from [b]15% to 10%[/b]

[b]Booster card drop limit adjustments[/b]
- Bounty Hunter: Increased from [b]1 to 5[/b]
- Gatherer: Increased from [b]3 to 5[/b]
- Berserker: Increased from [b]3 to 5[/b]
- Thorns: Increased from [b]4 to 5[/b]
- Gem Collector: Increased from [b]2 to 5[/b]
- Mighty: Increased from [b]3 to 5[/b]
- Metabolism: Increased from [b]3 to 5[/b]
- Sprinter: Increased from [b]2 to 5[/b]
- Swimmer: Increased from [b]2 to 5[/b]

[h2]Planet changes & adjustments[/h2]
[b]Odysseum Dungeon - [u]Justice Valley[/u] changes[/b]
- Pit traps now feature a brief warning before collapsing
- Added checkpoint at swamp

[b]Boss Arena enhancements[/b]
- Additional fleeing and recharge zones added
- New checkpoint established within the arena
- Floating objects redesigned for safety to mitigate unintentional fatalities.

[b]Resource node balancing in Odysseum & Dragonora(biome dependant)[/b]
- Limestone resource nodes resource amount increased by 10-30%
- Wood resource nodes resource amount increased by 10-30%
- Clay resource nodes resource amount increased by 10-30%
- Hardwood resource nodes resource amount increased by 10-30%

[h2]Bug Fixes and Technical Improvements[/h2]
- Resolved an issue with the bridge build animation collider, the bridge seemed built, but the collider was not enabled - leading to unintentional deaths
- Patched the infinite coin glitch present in Odysseum
- Set text uppercase in the "NEED LVL" on resource hit popup
- Resolved issues with Kraken boss disappearance

This week there's two more updates planned connected with boosters & fishing mini-game. 

If you are experiencing in-game crashes please contact support in Discord - [url=https://discord.gg/myuniverse]https://discord.gg/myuniverse[/url]
We need more information & data in order to reproduce this issue and fix it.

Best Regards,
Stickman

notes.title: My Little Universe v1.1.4 Hot Fix #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767482/20bb517a9b959ff20ac77170f48311a855322f68.png[/img]
Good evening [b]dear players[/b], it's great to read all your feedback in forums & steam reviews. Team is working hard to fix any issues you have reported so far, so here's another minor hot fix patch fixing several issues reported.
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with booster card XP bar not filling up properly
[*] Improved overall mouse controls, now it should be possible to click through all the menus with mouse controls and keyboard controls alike
[*] Fixed issue that appeared in version [b]Hot Fix v1.1.2[/b], which caused players playing on controller not being able to change settings while using a controller. This bug did not happen to players using keyboard/mouse controls
[*] Fixed issue with multiple windows opening on top of each other (like refinery window opening on top of map e.t.c.)
[*] [b]Restored[/b] fishing spots in [b]Asium[/b], now all fishing spots are fixed and shouldn't cause any issues to the players
[*] Fixed issue with [b]Wadirum Challenge B[/b], where after killing second boss, it did not spawn the 3rd boss - making the level unable to be completed
[*] Other small fixes
[/list]

We are still continuing to investigate the issue with some players having game crashes on game launch. If you have a similar issue - please report it to our discord or make a post under discussion forum.

[i]One of the possible solutions for such crash is to launch the game in Administrator mode, as from reports received until now - game only crashes if it doesn't have permissions to write the save file on game launch.[/i]

Have fun playing the game,
Your's trully
Stickman aka Joy

notes.title: My Little Universe: The Glow-Up from Mobile to PC is Real! 🌌
notes.content:
As many of you know, "My Little Universe" started its journey as a mobile game. While it was a fantastic experience there, we wanted to push the boundaries and make it even more immersive for PC players. Today, we're excited to walk you through the upgrades that make the PC version a whole new adventure! 🌠

[b]New Features Exclusive to PC Version[/b]

1. [b]Manual Controls:[/b] Say goodbye to auto-selection. Now you have the power to choose your actions. Swing that axe or sword yourself! This adds an extra layer of depth and control to the game. (Available in the demo)
2. [b]Local Co-op Mode/Split Screen:[/b] Team up for twice (or quadruple) the fun! This is perfect for a game night or just hanging out with friends! (Full version feature)
3. [b]Remote Play Together for Steam Users:[/b] Get ready to invite your friends to your universe, no matter where they are! (Full version feature)
4. [b]Booster Cards:[/b] Earn special perks like increased swimming speed or reduced fire damage. Customize your gameplay to suit your style! (Full version feature)
5. [b]Special Charged Superpowerful Attacks:[/b] Because who wouldn't want to chop down all nearby trees with a single hit? (Available in the demo)
6. [b]Map:[/b] Navigating the vast universe has never been easier. (Full version feature)
7. [b]Full Gamepad Support:[/b] Whether you're a keyboard warrior or a gamepad guru, we've got you covered. (Available in the demo)
8. [b]Improved Graphics:[/b] We've cranked up the visuals for a more immersive and beautiful experience. (Available in the demo)
9. [b]Unique Planet in Demo:[/b] Yes, you read that right. The demo itself comes with a special unique planet for you to explore.

Let us know what you think, and as always, happy exploring! 🚀

notes.title: Celebrating 1K Followers with Unforgettable Stats - Thank You!
notes.content:
Greetings, space explorers!

We are overjoyed to share with you that the "My Little Universe" community on Steam has reached a fantastic milestone - [b]1,000 followers![/b] 🎉🚀

This incredible achievement is a testament to your unyielding support, engagement, and love for exploring our little universe. And for that, we can't thank you enough! 🙏💖
To mark this momentous occasion, let's take a look at some staggering stats from our demo version!

So from demo release day, our industrious players have gathered:

• 172,174,000 Coins
• 114,669,000 Wood
•  21,266,000 Azurites
•  20,739,000 Ruby
•  26,877,000 Sulphur
•  115,103,000 Rocks
•  9,238,000 Uranium
•  17,577,000 Diamonds

And also [b]you have taken down a whopping 248,000 crabs![/b] 🤣

These amazing numbers are a testament to your commitment, creativity, and adventurous spirit. We can't wait to see what more we'll achieve together as our universe continues to grow and expand.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being a part of this exciting journey. Here's to countless more adventures in "My Little Universe"! 🌌

Stay tuned for more updates and keep exploring the cosmos. [b]Together[/b], we can make this universe a little more our own!

notes.title: New Update Now Live: Bug Fixes and Game Improvements
notes.content:
Greetings, space explorers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767482/96371e65e71961d6bd9b0752504d877317f75d03.png[/img]

We want announce the [b]latest update for "My Little Universe"[/b] which aims to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a rundown of what's new and improved:

[list]
[*] Fixed a save file issue where players could not play the game for the 2nd time.
[*] Camera switching after mounting the raft has been fixed.
[*] Removed mouse cursor during gameplay for a smoother experience.
[*] We've adjusted default camera sensitivity.
[*] Refineries and upgrade stations pop-up windows have been adjusted for better in-game flow.
[*] Improved navigation in the settings menu for your convenience.
[*] Adjusted the cannon attack for the Pirate boss for a balanced challenge.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could pick up resource piles more than once.
[*] Resource requirements for building tiles now adjust properly when the camera zooms in.
[*] Other minor bugs have been squashed for a seamless play.
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] updating the game may corrupt your current DEMO save. We apologize for any inconvenience!

Keep exploring, keep building, and keep creating your own little universe! 🚀🌌

Your feedback is always appreciated as we continue to refine and improve "My Little Universe". 

Thank you for your ongoing support! 🧡
